what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: How to hand keys to paying customers: what Stripe and others do, and a design sealing keys to the buyer's own key.
sections.para: Keys as stock, via claim codes.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: We sell keys; Stripe stops at payment; others do more; none seals to the buyer; our function; claim codes.

sections.label: The problem
sections.line: Sends, vaults, access keys and cells all end in a key, and our Stripe link stops at the redirect.
sections.para: The hand-over is ours to build.

sections.label: What Stripe does, and does not
sections.line: Stripe gives a reference, a signed webhook, a redirect, products without stock, entitlements and Workflows in preview.
sections.para: No keys, no stock, no buyer keys.

sections.label: What the others do
sections.line: FastSpring sells from a key list or calls your server; Paddle Classic did; Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Gumroad generate keys.
sections.para: All hold keys in clear; none knows the buyer's key.

sections.label: The design I want
sections.line: A key pair before checkout, the fingerprint as reference, a Lambda that seals a key from stock, a QR on redirect.
sections.para: Only the buyer can open it.

sections.label: Keys as stock
sections.line: Give a provider single-use claim codes to sell and count; the buyer claims, we seal the real key.
sections.para: No provider holds a real key.

sections.label: What I would do now
sections.line: Keep Stripe for money, build the one function, key pairs at checkout, claim codes elsewhere, watch Workflows.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Features change and some sources are secondary; the design is not built; fees and tax are separate.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Stripe, FastSpring, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar and Square documentation, and earlier articles.
